title: 第11章 修行资源
slug: 掠天记全本免费-掠天记最新章节列表
content_zh:
此时已经是深夜，杜方盘膝坐在床上，房内摆设简单，胜在干净与清幽。
在他面前，摆放了一本薄薄的小册子，正是晋升了外门弟子后领取的修行法诀。
这修行法诀，与青云锻气篇区别不大，只是详尽了许多，应该是正宗的青云锻气篇，与这本修行法诀比起来，做道童的时候修炼的那本法诀，简直就是简单的令人发指，根本就是只简单介绍了一下修行的道理，与吐纳调息，和运转灵气的基础法门，其他的没了。
不过想来也是，道童们手里的法诀，本来就是用来测试他们的灵性的，不需要太高深。
而且道童们做工十年，便会谴送下山，太高深的法门给了他们，也容易外泄。
而外门弟子，可在青云宗修炼三年，若是无法破入灵动第二重，便会被谴送下山。
破入灵动第二重后，便可继续修行三年，若是无法破入灵动第三重，一样会被谴送下山。
而破入灵动三重之后，则会有五年时间，若是五年之内无法破开瓶颈，进入灵动第四重，还是会被谴送下山，其他几个阶段也是一样，青云宗并不会一直白养着这些弟子。
就算留在了宗门里的弟子，平时发放的资源也少得可怜，若想获得足够的修行资源，要么花费大量的金钱向宗门购买，要么领取道门符诏，替道门完成任务获取奖励，当然了，还有一种就是进入道门的各个监司，就像胖道人那样，也有微薄的资源可以赚取。
“呼……”
方行开始修炼，运转青云宗心法，灵气外泄，吐纳调息。
在他面前，红彤彤的灵石随着他的呼息轻轻的上下浮沉，飘飞在空中，煞是神异。
通过这种调息之法，灵气之上的灵力便被他汲入了体内，渗入经脉。
正式成为了外门弟子后，准确的说是知晓了灵石的妙处之后，方行便不再用那种以化精草炼精化气的法门来修炼了，那种方法太伤身体，虽然他在用这个法门修炼的两个月里，一直通过大吃大喝来弥补精气，但身体还是不可避免的受到了很重损耗。
人的身体一旦亏空，不是大吃大喝就能弥补回来的，除非是有绝世秘药才有可能。
如今的方行才十岁年龄，但头发里却有一些灰白发色出现，都是这两个月里炼出来的，若是他继续用炼精化气的法门修炼下去，或许他根本就活不到二十岁。
他不像那些高资质的人，可以直接通过吐纳调息来修炼，只能从外界直接汲取灵气，如今他用来修炼的这枚灵石，便是修行界里一种蕴含灵性的特殊矿石，修行之人在吐纳调息之时，灵气贯注于上，然后运转玄法，就可以将灵石之中蕴含的灵气一丝丝纳入自己体内。
这种方法不伤本源，反而会使得人身体康健，延年益寿，体魄强壮，但修为提升的速度却与“炼精化气”的法门相差极远，甚至可以说是一个是跑着，一个却是走着，但这也是很无奈的事情，总不能为了一时的修行，却连命也不要了吧？
“炼精化气”是条修炼捷径，却是条要人命的捷径！
再者就是，使用灵石修炼，太耗财钱！

如今的方行用这种方法修炼还不是很纯熟，但也估摸着最多十天，这一块灵石便会消耗光了，剩下的时间可怎么办呢？修行这东西，如逆水行舟，不进则退，若是一连五十天得不到灵气补充，本来已经修炼了出来的灵气，也有可能慢慢的消减……
这就跟人好容易吃了饱饭，有了点力气，但剩下的好几天吃不饱，身体也会虚弱一般。
胖道人入门已经第七个年头了，就是因为资源严重不足，时断时续，修为才涨涨停停，总是无法突破灵动二重，其实他已经有两次险此被谴送下山了，都是通过托关系，走后门，把仅有的一点资源拿去送礼，再加上在杂司监兢兢业业的办事，才留了下来。
不过越是这样，他越是缺少资源，也没时间好好修炼，修为就更上不去了。
“不行，看样子修行这件事，跟外面一样，撑死胆大的，饿死胆小的，我要是这么老老实实的混下去，早晚跟猪师兄一样，在道门里给人当跑腿的命……”

content_en:
It was already late at night, and Du Fang was sitting cross-legged on the bed. The furnishings in the room were simple, but it was clean and quiet.
In front of him, there was a thin booklet, which was the cultivation method he received after being promoted to an outer disciple.
This cultivation method is not much different from the Qingyun Qi Forging Chapter, but it is much more detailed. It should be the authentic Qingyun Qi Training Chapter. Compared with this cultivation method, the one I practiced when I was a Taoist boy is simply outrageous. It only briefly introduces the principles of cultivation, the basic methods of exhaling and breathing, and the movement of spiritual energy, and nothing else.
But thinking about it, the magic formulas in the hands of Taoist boys were originally used to test their spirituality, and they did not need to be too profound.
Moreover, Taoist boys who have worked for ten years will be punished and sent down the mountain. If too profound a Dharma is given to them, it will be easy to leak it.
As for the outer disciples, they can practice in Qingyun Sect for three years. If they cannot break through to the second level of spirituality, they will be sent down the mountain.
After breaking into the second level of spirituality, you can continue to practice for three years. If you fail to break through to the third level of spirituality, you will still be punished and sent down the mountain.
After breaking into the third level of spirituality, there will be five years. If you cannot break through the bottleneck within five years and enter the fourth level of spirituality, you will still be punished and sent down the mountain. The same is true for other stages. Qingyun Sect will not keep raising these disciples in vain.
Even the disciples who stayed in the sect were usually given very few resources. If they wanted to obtain enough training resources, they had to either spend a lot of money to buy them from the sect, or receive Taoist talisman edicts and complete tasks for the Taoist sect to get rewards. Of course, there is also the other way to go to the various supervisors who enter the Taoist sect. Just like the fat Taoist, they also have meager resources to earn.
"Huh..."
Fang Xing began to practice, operating the Qingyun Sect's mental method, leaking spiritual energy, and breathing in and out.
In front of him, the red spiritual stone floated up and down gently with his breath, flying in the air, which was truly magical.
Through this method of regulating his breath, the spiritual power above the spiritual energy was absorbed into his body and penetrated into his meridians.
After officially becoming an outer sect disciple, or to be precise, after knowing the wonders of spirit stones, Fang Xing no longer used the method of using essence grass to refine essence and gas.
Once a person's body is depleted, it cannot be replenished by eating and drinking, unless there is a peerless secret medicine.
Fang Xing is only ten years old now, but there are some gray hairs in his hair, which were all refined in the past two months. If he continues to practice the method of refining Qi, he may not live to be twenty at all.
Unlike those highly qualified people who can practice directly by breathing and breathing, he can only directly absorb spiritual energy from the outside world. The spiritual stone he is using now to practice is a special ore that contains spirituality in the world of cultivation. When a practitioner breathes and breathes, the spiritual energy is concentrated on it, and then he uses the mysterious method to absorb the spiritual energy contained in the spiritual stone into his body.
This method does not harm the origin, but will make people healthy, prolong life, and be strong. However, the speed of improvement in cultivation is far from the method of "refining essence and transforming qi". It can even be said that one is running and the other is walking. However, this is also a very helpless thing. You can't even risk your life for the sake of temporary cultivation, right?
"Refining Qi" is a shortcut for cultivation, but it is a shortcut that can kill people!
Furthermore, using spiritual stones to practice is too expensive!
Nowadays, Fang Xing is not very proficient in practicing this method, but he estimates that this spiritual stone will be used up in ten days at most. What will happen with the remaining time? Practicing this thing is like sailing against the current. If you don't advance, you will retreat. If you don't get spiritual energy replenishment for fifty days in a row, you will have already cultivated.The spiritual energy that comes may also slowly fade away...
This is like a person who finally eats enough and gains some strength, but then cannot eat enough for several days and becomes weak.
It has been the seventh year since Fat Taoist started his career. Due to the serious shortage of resources, his cultivation level has been rising and falling intermittently, and he has always been unable to break through the second level of agility. In fact, he has been almost condemned to be sent down the mountain twice. Both times were through the trust relationship, the back door, using the few resources to give gifts, and the conscientious work in the Miscellaneous Supervisor, so he stayed.
However, the more this happens, the less resources and time he has to practice properly, and the more he cannot improve his cultivation level.
"No, it seems that cultivation is the same as outside. The brave will be overwhelmed and the timid will be starved to death. If I continue to hang out like this, sooner or later, I will be like Brother Zhu, working as an errand boy in the Taoist sect..."
